hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross four lanes of traffic without a median or refuge island, increasing exposure to vehicles.

hazards.name: Faded crosswalk markings
hazards.description: The existing crosswalk markings are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to approaching drivers.

hazards.name: Uncontrolled Vehicle Access Points
hazards.description: Large, continuous curb cuts for the auto center on the right create an expansive area where vehicles can cross the pedestrian path unpredictably.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image, in front of the Matrix Auto Center

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Vehicles parked along the right curb and in the apron area block sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

hazards.name: Utility pole obstruction
hazards.description: A utility pole is located directly in the center of the narrow sidewalk on the right, reducing the effective width to less than 3 feet and forcing pedestrians toward the roadway.

hazards.name: Undefined driveway conflict zone
hazards.description: The large paved area on the left serves as a wide driveway and parking lot entrance without a defined pedestrian path, creating a high-risk conflict zone for anyone walking along that side.

hazards.name: Lack of crossing infrastructure
hazards.description: No marked crosswalks or pedestrian signage are visible, leaving pedestrians unprotected when attempting to cross this industrial corridor.

hazards.name: Wide Multi-lane Roadway
hazards.description: The four-lane road design encourages high vehicle speeds and creates a long, unprotected crossing distance for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Absence of Pedestrian Buffer
hazards.description: The sidewalk is directly adjacent to the curb and parked cars with no physical separation, increasing the risk of vehicle-pedestrian conflict.

hazards.name: Visual obstructions
hazards.description: The large tree and parked vehicles can obscure sightlines between drivers and pedestrians attempting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curb line on the far side

hazards.name: High-speed road geometry
hazards.description: The wide, straight multi-lane configuration and lack of traffic calming encourage high vehicle speeds.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Parking Obstruction
hazards.description: Multiple vehicles are parked across the entire width of the sidewalk, forcing pedestrians into the active roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Center and left foreground, along the building frontage.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian-Vehicle Separation
hazards.description: No physical barriers or clear markings distinguish the pedestrian zone from the vehicle maneuvering and parking zone.
hazards.location_in_image: Entire paved area between the building and the street.

hazards.name: High-Speed Roadway Geometry
hazards.description: Wide, straight lanes and a lack of traffic calming measures encourage high vehicle speeds.

hazards.name: Lack of pedestrian crossing signage
hazards.description: There are no visible signs or signals to alert drivers to the presence of the midblock crosswalk.

hazards.name: Wide Roadway
hazards.description: The excessive width of the travel lanes and the overall roadway encourages high vehicle speeds and increases pedestrian exposure during crossings.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the image, spanning the entire roadway width.

hazards.name: Lack of Protected Crossings
hazards.description: There are no visible marked crosswalks or pedestrian signals, forcing pedestrians to cross multiple lanes of traffic unprotected.
hazards.location_in_image: Throughout the visible stretch of the roadway.

hazards.name: Blank Frontage
hazards.description: Boarded-up windows and lack of active ground-floor uses reduce natural surveillance and 'eyes on the street'.

hazards.name: Uncontrolled Multi-lane Crossing
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross four lanes of traffic at a mid-block location without the protection of a signal or refuge island.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parking
hazards.description: Parked vehicles on the right side of the street may obscure pedestrians waiting to cross from the view of oncoming drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street near the crosswalk

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: The intersection in the foreground lacks any marked crosswalks, making pedestrian movements unpredictable for drivers.

hazards.name: Lack of Designated Crossings
hazards.description: No marked crosswalks are visible, which may lead to dangerous mid-block crossing attempts.

hazards.name: Inactive Frontage
hazards.description: Boarded-up windows on the large building reduce natural surveillance and 'eyes on the street'.
hazards.location_in_image: Large brick building on the left

hazards.name: Visual obstructions from parked cars
hazards.description: Parallel parked vehicles along the curb can obscure pedestrians, particularly children, from the sightlines of oncoming drivers.

interventions.title: High-visibility crosswalks
interventions.description: Install marked crossings with appropriate signage to define pedestrian right-of-way and improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb extensions
interventions.description: Implement bulb-outs at potential crossing locations to reduce exposure time and improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Access management
interventions.description: Consolidate and clearly define driveways on the right side to minimize conflict zones between vehicles and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Install Bollards
interventions.description: Install permanent bollards along the curb line to prevent vehicles from parking on and obstructing the sidewalk.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair
interventions.description: Repair cracks and resurface the sidewalk to ensure a smooth, accessible walking surface for all users.

interventions.title: Street Trees or Planters
interventions.description: Add a furniture zone with trees or planters to provide a physical and psychological buffer between pedestrians and traffic.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Replace standard parallel lines with continental or ladder markings to increase visibility to drivers.

interventions.title: Road Diet
interventions.description: Reduce the number of travel lanes or lane widths to slow traffic and provide space for a buffered sidewalk or bike lane.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Midblock Crossing
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with signage and potentially a RRFB (Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacon) to facilitate safe crossing.

interventions.title: Driveway Consolidation
interventions.description: Reduce the number and width of curb cuts to create a more predictable environment for both drivers and pedestrians by defining specific entry and exit points.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer
interventions.description: Introduce a planting strip or furniture zone to separate the walking area from the travel lanes, providing physical and psychological protection.

interventions.title: Clear Path Maintenance
interventions.description: Relocate the large pole or widen the sidewalk to ensure a consistent, unobstructed clear width for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at corners or mid-block to reduce crossing distance and prevent illegal parking that blocks sightlines.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening and Buffering
interventions.description: Increase the width of the walkway and add a buffer zone (e.g., bollards or planters) to protect pedestrians from traffic and parking encroachments.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Replace faded markings with continental or ladder-style high-visibility markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening and Obstruction Removal
interventions.description: Widen the existing sidewalk to at least 6 feet and relocate utility poles to a dedicated furniture zone to provide a clear, ADA-compliant path of travel.

interventions.title: Driveway Consolidation and Continuous Sidewalk
interventions.description: Install a continuous sidewalk across the large driveway on the left, using curb extensions to narrow the vehicle entry point and clearly prioritize the pedestrian path.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks and RRFBs
interventions.description: Install marked crosswalks with Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacons to alert drivers to the presence of pedestrians.

interventions.title: Landscaped Buffer Strip
interventions.description: Add a planting strip with street trees between the sidewalk and the curb to provide physical protection and improve the walking environment.

interventions.title: Midblock Crossing
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk with appropriate signage and potentially a pedestrian refuge island to provide a designated crossing point.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Enhance safety at night by adding lighting specifically directed at the sidewalk and potential crossing areas.

interventions.title: Designated On-Street Parking
interventions.description: Clearly mark on-street parking spaces to provide a legitimate alternative to sidewalk parking.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Clear Zone Enforcement
interventions.description: Implement strict enforcement and signage to ensure a minimum clear path for pedestrians is maintained at all times.

interventions.title: Midblock Crossing with Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with a raised median refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer and Street Trees
interventions.description: Introduce a planting strip or furniture zone between the sidewalk and the curb to provide physical and psychological separation from traffic.

interventions.title: Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacons (RRFB)
interventions.description: Add user-actuated flashing lights to increase driver yielding rates at the midblock crossing.

interventions.title: Midblock Pedestrian Crossing
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk with a pedestrian refuge island to provide a safe crossing point.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planting Strips
interventions.description: Install street trees or a planting buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway to provide physical separation and improve the environment.

interventions.title: Building Activation
interventions.description: Encourage the restoration of windows or the addition of murals to the blank facade to improve the pedestrian experience.

interventions.title: Parking Enforcement and Bollards
interventions.description: Implement strict parking enforcement and install bollards to keep the sidewalk clear of vehicles.

interventions.title: Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacon (RRFB)
interventions.description: Add user-actuated amber LEDs to the crossing signs to increase driver yielding rates.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install high-visibility continental crosswalks at the intersection to improve pedestrian visibility and safety.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Improvement
interventions.description: Clear obstructions and widen the sidewalk on the right side to provide a continuous, accessible path.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Mid-block Crosswalk
interventions.description: Implement a marked crossing with high-visibility 'continental' striping and pedestrian warning signage to formalize crossing points.
